caption_L1: Ecolab 's number of employees from 2009 to 2019 is a area plot. A linear scale of range 0 to 40,000 can be seen on the y-axis, marked Number of employees. Year is measured along a linear scale from 2010 to 2018 on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: The number of employees at ecolab has doubled since the year 2010, up to roughy 50,000. This increase was the most rapid between 2010 and 2012. After this the growth has slowed substantially and the increase was at a constant rate.
